about: Measured per scene frame from the rendered, skinned meshes (build/render.py writes meas_*.json, build/trace.py turns them into this). The camera closes in from 21.5 s to 25 s, so x_world_measured (the dog's floor contact inverted through that frame's camera, metres along the score's x) is the position measure. facing: -1 = head toward the door (left), +1 = head away. state comes from the measured onsets below, not from the score labels.

onset_rules.retreat: first frame the measured floor position moves away from the door by > 2 cm
onset_rules.watch_1: first frame after that the measured speed falls under 0.35 m/s
onset_rules.refuse: first frame the head drops more than 8 % below its height at 3.3 s (the flinch that starts the turn)
onset_rules.watch_2: first frame the measured head is again on the door side of the tail (facing the door)
onset_rules.approach: first frame the measured floor position moves toward the door by > 2 cm
onset_rules.lie_down: first frame the measured back line sinks more than 8 % below its height at 23.5 s
onset_rules.look_in: first frame the head moves 3 px toward the doorway from where it was at 26.2 s
